verdict.rationale: Apple publishes some concrete numbers (up to 64GB unified memory, 273GB/s bandwidth, Thunderbolt 5 speeds, display/battery specs) but wraps most claims in marketing adjectives ('blazing speed', 'massive increase') rather than a full spec sheet; no CPU/GPU clock speeds, no AI TOPS figure, and no disclosed test conditions/methodology are given, and community comments note inconsistent generation-to-generation comparisons that obscure real benchmarking. missing for 10: clock speeds, AI TOPS metric, disclosed benchmark test conditions/methodology.
